WITH bounds AS ( SELECT ST_TileEnvelope(#{z}, #{x}, #{y}) AS g3857, ST_Transform(ST_TileEnvelope(#{z}, #{x}, #{y}), 4326) AS g4326 ), rows AS ( SELECT ST_AsMVTGeom( ST_Transform( CASE WHEN #{z} <= 8 THEN ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(f.geom, 0.002) WHEN #{z} <= 11 THEN ST_SimplifyPreserveTopology(f.geom, 0.00035) ELSE f.geom END, 3857 ), b.g3857, 4096, 64, true ) AS geom, COALESCE(f.name, '') AS name, f.sub_type AS subtype, f.layer AS layer, CAST(f.osm_id AS text) AS osm_id FROM osm_feature f CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE f.layer = #{layer} AND f.geom && b.g4326
AND ( #{z} >= 14 OR f.sub_type NOT IN ('service','footway','path','cycleway','track','steps','pedestrian','bridleway','corridor') ) AND ( #{z} >= 11 OR f.sub_type IN ('motorway','motorway_link','trunk','trunk_link','primary','primary_link','secondary','secondary_link','tertiary','tertiary_link') ) AND ( #{z} >= 6 OR f.sub_type IN ('motorway','motorway_link','trunk','trunk_link','primary','primary_link') )
AND #{z} >= 13
AND #{z} >= 10
AND #{z} >= 7 AND ( #{z} >= 12 OR f.sub_type IN ('river','canal','flowline') )
AND #{z} >= 6
AND #{z} >= 8
AND #{z} >= 4
AND ( #{z} >= 11 OR (#{z} >= 8 AND f.sub_type IN ('city','town','county','suburb','quarter')) OR f.sub_type IN ('city','town') )
)
SELECT encode(ST_AsMVT(rows, #{layer}, 4096, 'geom'), 'base64') FROM rows WHERE geom IS NOT NULL
